svg.title: Known-best packing of 176 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=176 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the free grid slack closed and the near-axis squares straightened at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete aeacc6c rational centre/half-angle certificate converted exactly from a checkout at the pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, interval, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=176 regularized: side ~ 13.81285625 (certified upper bound)
